notes: Continuation of the original two-way and prescribed-parent cases from 10 to 30 seconds with unchanged scientific parameters, grids, and 2.4× Cho damping.
Parent and current resume their saved solver checkpoints. Cho resumes the last saved Float32 roughness field; it is not reset to zero or replayed from the beginning.
The late surface clip shows 29–30 seconds; the startup clip shows the continuation at 10–11 seconds. Original 0–10 second outputs remain in the original gallery.
This deliberately retains the original nine-mode parent and weak-current setup. The separate Veron–Wagner experiment addresses its physical limitations.
